definition: The real clock time at which stage n of the convergent schedule begins: 1 - (1/2)^n, measured in units of the whole schedule, so stage 0 begins at time 0 and each later stage begins halfway between the previous stage time and 1.
note: The standard dichotomy-style halving schedule, chosen as the strongest pro-supertask mathematical model that #318 asks to be stated. It is a mathematical clock assignment, not a reading of Zeno or Aristotle; a sourced reading would need a pinned passage (for example Physics VI.2 or VI.9) and a separate claim.
